# FlareColorRole

`Flare.Components.FlareColorRole`

Semantic color roles shared across Flare components.

| Name | Value | Description |

| `Default` | `0` | The component's theme default color (no explicit role). |
| `Primary` | `1` | Primary brand color - the main accent. |
| `Secondary` | `2` | Secondary accent color. |
| `Tertiary` | `3` | Tertiary accent color. |
